title: Descent of a natural fibre isomorphism through localization
statement: Let W be a morphism property of C and F,G functors from C to A that invert W. Every natural isomorphism F to G induces an isomorphism between their explicit localization lifts. Its component at the image of X is its original component at X. Equality is detected on these components.

source.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d), pp.146-147; explicit part of the fibre transport argument

proof.text: Apply the inverse of the equivalence between localization functors and W-inverting functors to the given natural isomorphism. The component formula for natTransExtension gives the asserted component. The object equivalence of the explicit localization proves extensionality.

proof_origin.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d); complete Lean construction for lem-wf-fibre-functor-basepoint-transport
